propositions: Blocking edges written before the structural type-tier rule landed are now wrong under the shipped rule and never self-heal, distorting ready, next-batch and the claim cascade.
A read-only store-wide scan classifies each net-active blocking edge by delegating to resolve_hierarchy_link, yielding ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, unreadable, or clean.
Opt-in --repair unlinks ancestor-blocking edges and replaces mis-escalated edges, writing the LINK before the UNLINK so no dependency is lost and repair is resumable and idempotent.
Ambiguous ordered pairs carrying more than one net-active link, cyclic or closed-ticket replacements, and other write failures are reported unrepairable, left in place, and do not abort the run.

Default invocation is read-only, takes no lock and reconverges nothing, while --repair takes the store write lock, aborts if a reconciler is in flight, and pre-tags the tracker OID as pre-link-audit-repair.
Any outstanding finding after a pass yields exit code 1 so a partially-repaired store is never reported clean.
